scope: Offline causal FIR prediction of archived R1-R6 voltage responses. No neural, body or connectome execution.
input_units: Stored Origin light-input units; no conversion to absorbed photons claimed
output_units: Published relative voltage mV; existing source preprocessing retained
lag_rationale: Fixed engineering horizon, not a measured or universal biological time constant
development_rule: Build lag windows within each slice separately; discard first 80 targets of each slice. Select lowest pooled validation MSE, tie chooses first penalty. No test-response centering, gain fit, time shifts or hyperparameter tuning.
final_fit: Refit selected penalty on both complete training waveforms after discarding first 80 samples separately. Mean of 20 primary-cell trials is target.
baselines: current input linear regression, identical scored samples
causal FIR trained with each training stimulus circularly shifted by 1000 samples; same selected penalty
excluded_duplicate: Supplement n1 exactly equals primary 20-trial mean in all five BG0.5 conditions; excluded from transfer. Other backgrounds have unresolved identities and are not fit here.

acceptance.interpretation: Engineering usefulness thresholds, not biological equivalence or welfare validation. Transfer median is across 18 cell-condition traces, not 18 independent animals. Report all failures without retuning.

limitations: Bandwidth holdout is not independent-animal or proven independent-random-seed validation.
Population traces are cell means; cell identity across backgrounds is unresolved.
Existing published relative-voltage preprocessing may use whole-record statistics.
No claim about R7/R8, absolute membrane potential, photon scale, adaptation generality, learning or absence of suffering.
